newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile January-May copper output climbs on 1996.
newsitem.headline: Chile January-May copper output climbs on 1996.

text.p: Chilean copper production totaled 1.41 million tonnes in the January-May period, up 13.8 percent from the first five months of 1996, said the National Statistics Institute (INE) in its monthly report.
Chile mined 338,562 tonnes of fine copper in May, 29 percent higher than in the same month last year.
This figure was skewed artificially higher by companies registering production of around 20,000 tonnes in May which was actually produced in the January-April period, INE said.
INE figures showed metallic mining output rising 27 percent in May compared with the same month last year.
